# A cost stated on a share purchase, in a transaction with no CAD figure in
# it. Shares are counted and priced rather than converted, so a security has
# no cost basis here and nothing would ever read this — and with the whole
# transaction in USD there is no derived cost for anything to notice the
# stored one by. Refused at the door instead, on the same terms as a stated
# balance on the same split.
2024-03-06 * "Buy USTECH with a cost stated on it"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Brokerage:USTECH 10 USTECH
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USTECH"
		share_price: "50"
		value: "500.00"
		cost_basis_cost: "50 CAD/USTECH"
	Assets:USD Cash -500.00 USD
